lines.en: I come flying from the cliff side.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是金属的，扇起来很沉
lines.en: My wings are metal and beat heavily.
I skim over the pine forest.

lines.zh: 我的影子一格一格地移过树顶
lines.en: My shadow moves tree by tree.

lines.zh: 风吹在甲片上，有金属声
lines.en: Wind on my plates makes a metal sound.
I fly along the ridge without climbing.
I glide past the cliff face.

lines.zh: 我从云下穿过去，云被切开
lines.en: I pass under a cloud and it parts.
My eyes sweep the valley.
I glide a stretch and beat once.

lines.zh: 我从一道山缝里穿过去
lines.en: I slip through a gap in the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在空中划出弧
lines.en: My wings carve arcs in the air.
I fly low over a lake.

lines.zh: 我顺着上升的热气流升高
lines.en: I rise on a thermal.

lines.zh: 我停在岩石上，翅膀收着
lines.en: I perch on the rock, wings folded.
My metal feet grip the stone.

lines.zh: 山风从我甲片的缝里过
lines.en: Mountain wind passes through my seams.

lines.zh: 我低下头整理翅下的片
lines.en: I lower my head to settle a plate under my wing.
Clouds drift below the mountain.
I turn my head toward the valley.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里成烟
lines.en: My breath smokes in the cold air.
I stay still, like a piece of iron.
I shake one wing.
Nothing else stirs on the summit.
I draw my head into the collar plates.
A river glints below.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石上换了位置
lines.en: My claws shift on the stone.
Wind drives the clouds fast.
I look down at you from height.
You stand on the mountain path, very small.
My wings open once.

lines.zh: 你的声音到不了这个高度
lines.en: Your voice does not reach this height.
I turn my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石上刮了一声
lines.en: My claws scrape the stone once.
I am in no hurry to come down.
I half-open my wings.
I lean out from the rock to see you.
This mountain path is narrow.
You climb, and I watch upward.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你前面的石上
lines.en: My shadow lies on the stone ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我的甲把你的影子挡了一下
lines.en: My plates cut your shadow in two.

lines.zh: 我的爪子松开岩沿又扣紧。
lines.en: My claws loosen on the ledge, then grip again.

lines.zh: 你在山道拐角抬头看我。
lines.en: At the trail's bend, you look up at me.

lines.zh: 你辨不出我从哪座峰来。
lines.en: You can't tell which peak I came from.
A plate on my wing is crooked.
I land on the rock to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一边慢了一拍
lines.en: One wing beats a beat slow.
I give a low metallic sound.
One wing hangs low.
I land on the rock, breathing heavily.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里冒出一点烟
lines.en: A little smoke comes from my seams.
An armor plate is hammered inward.

lines.zh: 一块岩片被我蹬落山崖。
lines.en: A slab of rock kicks loose beneath my claws.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，翅膀护住胸口
lines.en: I give half a step, wings guarding my chest.
Is that scrap in your hand?
I cannot smell it; the wind is strong.
I fly down a stretch.
This can be eaten, and used.

lines.zh: 我落在离你远一点的石上
lines.en: I land on a stone further off.
Set it down and I will come.

lines.zh: 那种东西在山上找不到
lines.en: That kind of thing is not found up here.
I fly lower to see it clearly.

lines.zh: 你把它举高，我就落下来
lines.en: Hold it up and I will come down.

lines.zh: 我先落在你上方的岩上
lines.en: I land on the rock above you first.
I lower my head, close to it.
There is iron in the smell.
You hit my plate, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，翅膀张开稳身
lines.en: I give half a step and spread my wings for balance.
We collide with an iron note.
I lift a foot and pebbles roll away.
My wing meets you, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，退了一步
lines.en: You hit my leg and step back.
I spread my wings to steady.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，山谷里有回音
lines.en: We collide and the valley answers.

lines.zh: 我踩落的石子滚了半天
lines.en: The stones I knock loose roll a long way.
I turn aside to let you pass.
She circles above me.

lines.zh: 我们两个的影子在山脊上重了
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the ridge.
Her plates carry old scratches.
We ride the mountain wind down together.
She lands on the rock beside me.

lines.zh: 她落在我上面的那块岩上
lines.en: She lands on the rock above me.
We turn toward the valley together.

lines.zh: 我们并排在岩台上收翅。
lines.en: We fold our wings side by side on the rock ledge.

lines.zh: 我们一起拍翅，声音叠着
lines.en: We beat together, the sounds layering.

lines.zh: 她替我把歪掉的甲片压平
lines.en: She presses a crooked plate flat.
I lower my head and take it in a claw.
It is iron; good enough.
I tuck it under my wing.
I lower my head to search again.
I land, claws touching stone first.
I take it firmly.
I look; it is good iron.
Iron feathers, and I can carry a rider.
I take it in both claws.
I hold it in my beak.

lines.zh: 金属翅展开，遮住半边天。
lines.en: My metal wings spread, covering half the sky.
I drop down from height.
The wind pushes me your way.
My sight locks onto you.
I spread my wings fully.
I begin a fast descent.
My claws are out.

lines.zh: 山风把我的视线吹不偏。
lines.en: The mountain wind can't blow my gaze off you.
The wind at the pass is right.
I drop low, close to the cliff.
I dip my head a little.
My tail feathers spread like a rudder.
I circle once above you.
You look up and I am under the cloud.
I follow along the mountain path.
My shadow stays over you.
I follow along the cliff face.
You look up and see only a shadow.
I keep to this altitude.

lines.zh: 我的翅声在山谷里回响
lines.en: My wingbeats echo in the valley.

lines.zh: 你走到开阔地，我就下了
lines.en: You reach open ground, and I descend.
I am in no hurry; the wind helps me.
Each circle brings me lower.

lines.zh: 你退到崖边，那里没有路
lines.en: You back to the cliff; there is no path.
I dive down at an angle.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀拍过去，像铁板
lines.en: My wing swings like a steel plate.
My beak stabs straight down.
After the blow I climb away.
I come from above, claws first.
My wing sweeps across.
I peck your shoulder.
I strike and fly off.
My wings are built of iron plates.
I land behind you.
I miss, turn, and climb again.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你袖上留下痕
lines.en: My claws leave marks on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 山脊上先出现一个铁点
lines.en: An iron speck appears on the ridge first.

lines.zh: 我把双翼张开，风撑满了
lines.en: I spread both wings and the wind fills them.
I come out of the cloud.
A new scratch appears on the stone.
My claws come down on the rock.
The wind at the pass parts around me.
The wind at the pass shifts first.
I emerge from beneath the cloud.
My plates catch the sun.
I settle on a high rock.
The clouds below me churn.
I fold my wings halfway.
I look down at this mountain path.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下翅，石屑落下
lines.en: One wingbeat and stone chips fall.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，金属烫起来
lines.en: Fire heats my plates until the metal burns.

lines.zh: 我失了风，一路转着落下去
lines.en: I lose the wind and spiral down.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，我飞不起来
lines.en: Water fills my seams and I cannot fly.
The blast rolls my wings over.

lines.zh: 有东西打在甲上，弹开了
lines.en: Something hits my plate and glances off.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住我的两翼
lines.en: That force bears down on both my wings.

lines.zh: 废料不够，我的翅扇得发沉
lines.en: Not enough scrap; my wings beat heavy.

lines.zh: 雷打在我甲上，一路窜到爪
lines.en: Lightning hits my plates and runs to my claws.

lines.zh: 下面没有山了，我一直落
lines.en: No mountains below; I keep falling.
